blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Top seed Alex Eala passed her first test to secure at least a bronze medal in the Asian Games 2026 women’s tennis singles event on Wednesday. Eala, the heavy favorite to win it all, shook off a slow start to fend off a gutsy Joanna Garland of Chinese Taipei, 7-5, 6-0, in their quarterfinal duel at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Nagoya.
